subject: Hosted API retainer + commit onramp 1 proposal and ops handoff
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@retailnova.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-28T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API retainer + commit onramp — proposal

Hi Sanjay —

Great meeting today. Per our discussion, attached is a compact proposal that combines a 6-month retainer (to reserve steady capacity for RetailNova's personalization inference) with a staged hosted-commit onramp. High-level:

- Monthly commit: start at 1.5M tokens/month for months 1-2, step to 3M tokens/month for months 3-6.
- Burst pocket: 200k tokens per month for peak campaigns (auto-bill if consumed).
- Soft throttle thresholds at 85% of commit to surface alerts and avoid user-facing throttling.
- Rate bands: baseline 120 tokens/sec per route; premium lanes available with dedicated pooling (extra cost).
- Retainer covers prioritized capacity and two emergency fill-ins during the term.

Operational asks:
1) Signed SOW + PO to start provisioning (timeline ~2 weeks after SOW).
2) Short handoff call with your engineering and ops team (30-45 min) to map routes, expected QPS, and sampling for caching.
3) Confirmation of data retention/KMS preferences for the Private Mirror (if required).

I attached a short MOP and the SOW draft. If this matches, I can loop in Marissa and Naomi on the SOW redline and ops checklist.

Would you like to keep the burst pocket in place or convert some of it into committed tokens once we hit month 3 usage?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: RetailNova_MOP_v3.pdf (4 pages); SOW-hosted-commit-draft.docx (draft)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@retailnova.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Vasquez <elena@retailnova.com>, Procurement <procurement@retailnova.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API retainer + commit onramp — proposal

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and the docs. A few quick clarifications before we circulate to procurement:

- Can you confirm latency SLO for the premium lanes vs baseline? Our storefront needs 95th < 120ms for critical checkout flows.
- We prefer converting 50% of burst into committed tokens after month 3 if utilization trends persist — is that acceptable?
- For billing, Procurement will want invoicing monthly with a single consolidated invoice (no per-route invoices).

Looping in Elena (Head of Product) and Procurement. Elena — can you confirm the engineering handoff attendees?

Best,
Sanjay
Head of Growth, RetailNova

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@retailnova.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-30T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API retainer + commit onramp — proposal

Thanks Sanjay — quick answers:

- Latency SLO: premium lanes target 95th < 90ms on dedicated pools; baseline hosted target 95th < 140ms. We'll include explicit SLO language in the SOW for the checkout premium lane.
- Burst convert: yes, we can convert 50% of unused burst into committed tokens at start of month 4, contingent on usage reports for months 1-3. Add opt-out clause in SOW.
- Billing: single consolidated monthly invoice — noted.

Next steps:
1) I'll send a redline-ready SOW to procurement for PO intake. (Marissa — can you own procurement redline and invoice workflow?)
2) Karthik — scope premium pooling for checkout route and estimate additional monthly cost for dedicated lane.
3) Schedule 30-min handoff with RetailNova eng + ops next week. Naomi — own onboarding checklist and monitoring dashboard setup.

If we get a PO within two weeks, provisioning start estimated 10 business days after PO acceptance.

Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-hosted-commit-draft.docx (updated: will deliver redline)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API retainer + commit onramp — ops ownership

Jordan — I can take the procurement redline and invoice cadence. Action items from ops side:
- I'll prepare the invoice template and pricing appendix for Procurement (turnaround 1 business day after SOW redline).
- Naomi will prepare dashboard templates for per-route token breakdown and soft-throttle alerts.
- Recommend a joint onboarding call Oct 6 at 10:00 PT; I'll send calendar invite once Sanjay confirms.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice_template.xlsx (stub)

From: Procurement <procurement@retailnova.com>

Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@retailnova.com>, Elena Vasquez <elena@retailnova.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API retainer + commit onramp — SOW redline and PO

Marissa / Jordan —
We reviewed the SOW and have three redline items from Finance:
1) Net-45 payment term instead of Net-30.
2) Add an explicit late-fee waiver for the first billing cycle during onboarding.
3) Require a mutual audit clause limited to KMS and retention settings (no broad audit rights).

Also, please confirm the PO formatting — we need Redwood legal name, billing address, and a contact for invoice escalation on the SOW before issuing PO.

If you accept these, we can issue PO RN-2027-559 within 48 hours.

Procurement Team
RetailNova
procurement@retailnova.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Hosted API retainer + commit onramp — final steps and handoff (DocuSign link)

Thanks — agreed. We accept the three redlines: Net-45, onboarding cycle late-fee waiver, and the limited mutual audit clause for KMS/retention only. Marissa will insert billing contact and Redwood legal name/billing address into the SOW before sending for signature.

Action items (final):
- Marissa: update SOW with billing details and insert Procurement redlines (today).
- RetailNova Procurement: expect DocuSign for SOW RN-77421 within 24 hours; PO RN-2027-559 accepted once SOW signed.
- Karthik: estimate for premium lane monthly uplift (deliverable: cost appendix) — due 2027-10-07 EOD.
- Naomi: onboarding playbook + dashboard templates (deliverable: RetailNova onboarding folder link) — due 2027-10-08.
- Jordan: schedule Oct 11 handoff call, invite RetailNova eng + ops, Redwood eng, product ops.
